name: Zilliz Vector Lakebase
desc: Lake-native data platform that unifies storage and compute for AI workloads.
desc_zh: 为 AI 负载统一存储与计算的湖原生数据平台。
solves: A vector database alone leaves embeddings, documents and metadata in separate systems; one lake platform holds them together.
solves_zh: 只有向量数据库， Embedding、文档和元数据还散在各处；一个湖平台把它们放在一起。
best_for: Your retrieval stack has outgrown a single vector index and now spans several data types.
best_for_zh: 检索栈已经超出单一向量索引，开始覆盖多种数据类型。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — zilliz.com/blog）。 Blog post carries JSON-LD datePublished 2026-05-11T04:00:00.000Z. The next step beyond Zilliz Cloud; Milvus remains the open-source database the ledger holds. 首次公开日期来源：https://zilliz.com/blog/from-vector-database-to-vector-lakebase
